summary: EUDA Health Holdings Ltd filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) suspending its at-the-market (ATM) offering under a June 2025 agreement with Chardan Capital Markets, reducing the maximum aggregate offering price to zero. No shares were sold under the ATM program. The filing also notes a June 5, 2026, notice to terminate the ATM agreement, effective after 30 business days. This is a routine cessation of a shelf program, not a special situation like a capital return or restructuring. The ordinary shares trade on NASDAQ under EUDA. No actionable risk-arb angle exists.
